$comment: Locked Chinese terminology for Mysterria. This file is the authority: every
Chinese string that ships must use these renderings, and every AI translation
prompt injects it verbatim.
`canon: true` means the term appears in the original Qidian webnovel 《诡秘之主》
by 爱潜水的乌贼. Those renderings are NOT open to translator preference - they are
what the source fandom already reads, and a paraphrase reads as a bad fan
translation no matter how accurate it is. `canon: false` marks Mysterria's own
invented terms, translated in the novel's register but not quotable from it.
zh-TW is generated from zh-CN by OpenCC `s2twp` (see scripts/build-zh-tw.mjs).
Where the correct Traditional form is NOT what s2twp produces, the term is
listed in `openccOverrides` below and the converter is corrected after the fact.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/zh-tw/诡秘之主 - Traditional title and author
https://www.books.com.tw/products/0010876694 - Taiwan print edition (飛燕文創), title as published

$comment: Applied after s2twp. Left side is what s2twp emits, right side is correct.
Deliberately near-empty: opencc-js already gets the cases we checked right
(it emits 詭秘之主, matching the Taiwan print edition, and leaves 神秘 alone).
Add an entry only with evidence that s2twp is wrong for a specific phrase -
never a single-character rule like 秘->祕, which would corrupt 詭秘之主.
Taiwan vocabulary that s2twp misses is the native TW reviewer's pass; see
reviewCandidates.
Terms where Taiwan usage may differ from what s2twp emits, flagged for the
native TW/HK pass rather than guessed at now. Resolve each with a TW reader,
then move it into openccOverrides.
reviewCandidates.神秘學: TW often writes 神祕學. s2twp leaves 神秘學. Confirm which the TW print edition uses.
reviewCandidates.秘偶大師: Sequence 5 of the Fool pathway. Check whether the TW edition writes 祕偶大師.
reviewCandidates.詭秘侍者: Sequence 1 of the Fool pathway. Same 秘/祕 question as above.

core.note: Novel title. Taiwan print edition keeps 秘; do not let s2twp turn it into 詭祕之主.
One of the 22 routes to godhood. Never 路径 or 道路.
Both the rung (序列9) and the system. Never 等级 or 阶级.
Never 超凡者 - that is a different novel's term.
Never 药水 - that is the generic game word and reads as a mistranslation to this fandom.
The digestion technique: act the role the Sequence names.
Moving up a Sequence. Not 飞升, which carries Taoist-immortal connotations absent from the novel.
The single Sequence 0 seat per pathway.
Here TW DOES take 祕 - unlike the book title.
Mysterria rank for Sequence 3. The novel does not use a single fixed word here.
Mysterria page listing who holds the high Sequences.
Mysterria's supplementary routes outside the canonical 22.

DO NOT translate literally as 想象之环 or similar. The English name is a pun on 《宿命之环》(Circle of Inevitability), the sequel novel: swap Inevitability for Imagination and you get Minecraft's 'the only limit is your imagination'. 空想之环 keeps the pun intact, and 空想 is itself the canonical word the novel uses (空想家 = Visionary, 空想天使 = Angel of Imagination), so a LOTM reader hears the reference immediately. Flattening it to a literal rendering throws away the whole joke.
The sequel novel. Present only as the reference 空想之环 plays off.
Keep the COI acronym - it is the mod's distributed name and how players find it.

$comment: Keyed by the pathway id in src/assets/sources/pathway-abilities.json.
IMPORTANT - `zh-CN`/`zh-TW` is the PATHWAY label and comes from the novel's
Sequence 9, because that is how Chinese names a pathway. English "Fool
pathway" is 占卜家途径 (Seer pathway). `deity-zh-CN`/`deity-zh-TW` is the
Sequence 0 title - the god at the summit - which English happens to reuse as
the pathway name and Chinese does not. Do not swap them.
The ten boon pathways are Outer God (外神) routes from the novel, NOT Mysterria
inventions - the 22 are the Primordial Creator's routes plus six taken from
Outer Gods, and the Outer Gods have many more. Their zh values below are
PROVISIONAL translations standing in for canon that has not been looked up.
See i18n/checklist.boon-pathways.md before trusting any of them.

fool.note: Chinese names this route after its Sequence 9 (占卜家途径), not its Sequence 0. 愚者 is the god at its summit - use deity-zh-CN for the Sequence 0 throne, never as the pathway label.

aeon.canonLadder: 舞蹈家 / 托钵僧侣 / 受契之人 / 苦修士 / 猎命师 (then 环中人, 受难者, 罪人). The Outer God the plugin name 空想之环 puns on.
aeon.note: Outer God (外神) route. The label is the Outer God's own name rather than the Sequence 9 rung, so a reader can tell an Outer God route from one of the 22 at a glance. Mysterria's English ladder is a direct translation of the canon Chinese one, rung for rung.
